semiconductor_relevance: High — Ebara Corporation provides critical equipment and systems for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Ebara Corporation is a solution provider in the semiconductor industry, specializing in advanced equipment such as energy-efficient dry vacuum pumps, chemical mechanical polishing (CMP) systems, and unique bevel polishing systems. Their technologies support various stages of semiconductor production, enhancing yield and efficiency.
